title: Migrate all address derivations to upstream Yggdrasil
description: The zt3c.7 rollup children cover only the Zephyr 02xx prefix and still leave multiple implementations and canonical vectors on the rejected SHA-512-based LICHEN native profile. Migrate C lichen_yggdrasil_addr/identity address, Rust lichen-core and gateway/node callers, Python identity, firmware bridge copies, and pinned tests to byte-equal upstream AddrForKey vectors. Remove remaining ULA routing behavior where the settled decision requires it. Independent audit found lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c:317-332, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/identity_addr.c:49-67, rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:70-117, python/src/lichen/crypto/identity.py:206-234, rust/lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs:225-231, test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json:3-8,22-29, and firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.c:155-195. Acceptance: every implementation matches upstream AddrForKey/SubnetForKey pinned vectors; no implementation or fixture treats the rejected profile as canonical; relevant tests pass. This is a follow-up to project-LICHEN-zt3c.7.
